dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear and symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey baseline with a subtle blue-ish hue; median intensity is consistent across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-density dark-grey shading concentrated along the central longitudinal axis and posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradient between the primary grey canvas and localized darker shades.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct longitudinal sequence of small, dark, circular contrast points along the central dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear series of small, shadowed pits or segmented textural disruptions along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A unique linear arrangement of dark punctate markings or healed depressions following the dorsal ridge line.
